facets.name: source
facets.description: where the declaration is written: path relative to the project root, start and end as [line, column] (lines 1-based, columns in UTF-16 code units, 0-based), and the keyword it is written with

facets.name: axioms
facets.description: the axioms the declaration depends on, transitively, and whether `sorryAx` is among them

facets.name: annotation.claim
facets.description: `@[claim]` annotations recorded in the TrustAnnotations extension

facets.name: annotation.example_of
facets.description: `@[example_of]` annotations recorded in the TrustAnnotations extension

facets.name: annotation.nonexample_of
facets.description: `@[nonexample_of]` annotations recorded in the TrustAnnotations extension

edges.name: statement
edges.description: the constants the declaration's type mentions

edges.name: meaning
edges.description: what the declaration means: its statement for a proof; its statement and the data of its value, proofs skipped, for a definition

edges.name: term
edges.description: the type and the whole value, proofs included, restricted to targets that are nodes
